description: This source file contains the implementation of the StaticGatewayListProvider class, which provides a static list of gateways based on configured options within the Orleans messaging framework.

classes.name: StaticGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to supply a static list of gateway URIs, with configurable refresh period and options.

methods.name: StaticGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with options for gateways and refresh period.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider; here it performs no operation and returns a completed task.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns the list of gateway URIs configured in options.
